rows.speaker: System
rows.en: Defeat enemy forces

rows.speaker: Poseidal raid leader
rows.en:
Looks like you're too late!
We'll be taking the goods!

rows.speaker: Poseidal raid leader
rows.en:
I leave the rest to you all.
Show your loyalty to Lady Poseidal!

rows.speaker: Noin
rows.en: Captain Bright, what's the situation!?

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: Lieutenant Noin! I'm glad you made it back.

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: We were caught by surprise. We're at a disadvantage.

rows.speaker: Noin
rows.en: All our units have launched. Give us our orders!

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: Right, wipe out the enemy forces around the base!

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: Keep the damage to the base to a minimum!
Poseidal... a mere band of warmongers...
What are they after, making a move now?

rows.speaker: Ra Cailum operator
rows.en: Enemy reinforcements confirmed.

rows.speaker: Ra Cailum operator
rows.en: The classified material's been stolen from Hangar 1!

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: What!? Go after them, now!

rows.speaker: Ra Cailum operator
rows.en: We've lost contact with the pursuit squad!

rows.speaker: Ra Cailum operator
rows.en: They've probably been wiped out...!

rows.speaker: Ra Cailum operator
rows.en: Looks like everyone in base command got out.

rows.speaker: Ra Cailum operator
rows.en: All enemy signals in the area are gone.
...I'm told the base commander was killed in action.
Let's wait for word from UCE Headquarters.

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: Right. The Ra Cailum will hold position for now.

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: All hands, go help the wounded!
